newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel holds steady, little pre-Christmas buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel holds steady, little pre-Christmas buying.

text.p: NWE cracked fuel oil showed broadly unchanged prices on Tuesday, having riden out crude's ups and downs.
Traders said the market was fairly quiet with the exception of the barge sector.
High sulphur barges traded up to $122 and down to $119 fob a tonne ARA. Dealers said the turn down in prices was the result of one seller offering keen numbers.
"Maybe they have too much volume or bought the material cheaply because I think the market has some strength," said one barge trader.
Much will depend on whether shipper demand is sustained for the rest of the week.
The cargo market was very slow with dealers looking to the barges and towards crude for an indication to price cargoes.
"I don't think it has been moving much in the mid teens delivered," said one trader at a major.

Low sulphur cracked material was holding sub $130 fob NWE. A combination cargo - 22,000 tonnes of good quality fuel and 13,000 tonnes of coker gas oil was done at quotes related levels. "It's about $128 fob on the fuel and the whole cargo is heading into the U.S," said one dealer. -- +44 171 542 8980
